meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者必备！当您需要为多品类商品策划抖音、小红书等平台的带货视频时，一键生成包含痛点切入、产品展示与专业镜头设计的6阶段高质量视频脚本，轻松打造高转化营销内容，大幅提升品牌销量。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把商品卖点生成带镜头设计的带货视频脚本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为多品类商品快速产出高转化带货视频脚本
copy.tagline_en: Turn product selling points into video scripts with shot design
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce high-converting product video scripts

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 6 个阶段把商品信息变成电商带货视频脚本：先定目标人群与核心痛点，再写「痛点切入→产品展示→痛点解决」脚本，并给出镜头类型、运镜和字幕音乐建议。
howto.when: 当你要为商品策划抖音、小红书等平台的带货视频脚本，或需要电商视频营销指导时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这款自动喂食器写一个30秒的抖音带货脚本
say.note: 会先问人群、痛点、风格再动笔

say.text: 这是宠物用品，人群是25-35岁都市白领，风格用生活方式
say.note: 按6阶段流程产出脚本与镜头设计

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude turns product info into an e-commerce video script in 6 stages: defining audience and pain points, writing a pain-point → product → resolution script, plus shot types, camera moves, subtitle and music suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need a product marketing video script for Douyin, Xiaohongshu or similar platforms, or want e-commerce video marketing guidance.

say_en.text: Write a 30-second Douyin script for this automatic pet feeder.
say_en.note: Asks for audience, pain points and style first.

say_en.text: It's a pet product; audience is urban white-collar workers aged 25-35.
say_en.note: Runs the 6-stage flow, outputs script and shot design.

say_en.text: Add close-up and orbit shots, plus subtitle and music suggestions.
say_en.note: Returns shot types, camera moves and post tips.
